t: An open-source AI pendant that records conversations and sends them to your phone.
steps: Buy Omi from the official Omi Store for about 179 US dollars.
Charge the pendant on its magnetic charger.
Install the Omi app on your phone and pair the pendant over Bluetooth.
Record a short test conversation with a friend who agrees to it.
Read the summary in the app and search the transcript.
Browse the app marketplace and try a community integration.
Open the Omi docs on GitHub and read the firmware build guide.
Get the Firmware Developer Kit for about 60 US dollars before you flash custom firmware.
meta: Open Board. From $59.99. A few stores.
